prompt.value:
Derive ONLY the far background plate from this supplied complete meadow concept. Preserve the exact full 1536 by 1024 canvas, camera, horizon, enormous cream clouds, cloud silhouettes and lavender shadow planes, saturated blue sky, distant blue hills, tiny village and distant slender trees. Preserve the existing flat-color painted art direction. Do not restage, crop, zoom, rotate, recenter, change the time of day, or invent another scene.

Remove the large broad-canopied tree on the left, its middle-distance shrubs, and all close grasses and red flowers. Reconstruct the distant hills, sky or field that those objects were hiding, according to the surrounding picture. Below the horizon, continue a simplified golden distant field all the way to the bottom of the canvas, so removing the near layers never exposes an unpainted hole. Keep the visible original far scenery as close as possible. The fill behind the big tree must follow the existing horizon; do not fill the entire removed tree with sky.

Return ONE completely opaque PNG plate containing continuous sky, clouds, distant hills/village and distant field. No large tree, near grasses, red flowers, ghost silhouettes, new landmarks, text, border or transparency. This is reference-guided background reconstruction for a parallax layer, not a redesign.

Derive ONLY the middle depth layer from the supplied complete meadow concept: its actual large broad-canopied tree on the left, the associated middle-distance shrubs, and the continuous sun-gold meadow below their base. Preserve the tree's exact location, silhouette, size, branch shape, foliage palette and painted color masses. Preserve the field's horizon line and horizontal color bands. Keep the full 1536 by 1024 canvas coordinates, with no crop, zoom, recentering or movement of any visible object.

Remove the sky, clouds, distant blue hills, tiny village and its slender distant trees. These removed regions must be genuinely transparent, including holes through the large tree canopy. Retain the tree and near shrubs as opaque cutouts. Retain the golden meadow as a continuous opaque area from its original upper edge down to the bottom of the canvas. Remove all close foreground grasses and red flowers; reconstruct the uninterrupted golden meadow that they were hiding. Do not leave holes in the field where the foreground was removed.

Return ONE PNG with true transparent alpha outside the tree, middle shrubs and meadow. Follow their real silhouette boundaries; no rectangular sky backing, painted checkerboard, blue/white matte, halo or copied distant scenery. Do not add objects or detail, alter the flat-color art style, or include text, frame or watermark. This is a layer separation from the supplied scene, not a new composition.

Extract ONLY the nearest foreground foliage from the supplied meadow concept: the actual dark blue-green grasses and leaves, and the scattered coral-red poppy-like flowers along the bottom edge. Preserve their exact original positions, silhouettes, size, colors, overlap and simplified painted treatment. Retain the original bottom-edge crop and full 1536 by 1024 canvas. Do not move, zoom, recenter or rearrange the foreground.

Remove every other depth layer: golden meadow, large middle-distance tree and shrubs, village, hills, clouds and sky. Output ONE full-canvas PNG containing only the close grasses, leaves, flower stems and petals, on true transparent alpha everywhere else. The space between leaves and stems must be transparent, without patches of the golden field. Where needed, complete tiny missing portions of foreground stems coherently, but preserve visible shapes. Keep naturally antialiased clean edges without a white or golden halo.

No background color, ground plane, solid meadow band, new objects, characters, painted checkerboard, text, logo, border or watermark. This is the nearest cutout layer from the existing concept, not a replacement foreground design.

workflow.description: Derive three depth layers from a supplied concept image, prepare horizontal repeats, and compose them.
workflow.title: Meadow from concept to parallax
